prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering onboarding flows can yield major wins (+12.0%, +4.5%, +3.1%), but carries severe downside risk (-8.9%) or no clear effect, with positive predictions often being too optimistic.
Targeted copy changes focused on account persistence safety (+3.5%) and launch call-to-actions (+6.7%) were helpful, with launch CTA predictions being too low (+6.7% measured vs +0.5% predicted).
General intro and adoption protection copy changes showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns and interactive guides carry severe risk, frequently causing significant performance drops worse than predicted (-7.0%, -10.1%, -19.3%) or showing no clear effect.
Notifications, hints, waiting screen progress indicators, and checklist layout adjustments showed no clear effect across all tested rounds.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: +2.9% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, hint: +1.8% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -11.7% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +3.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +6.7% over 1 test(s)
- finish, layout: -5.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -8.6% over 2 test(s)
- home, notification: -1.3% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +1.0% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +3.5% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.5% over 4 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 78.3%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 85.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 67.1%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 22.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Stage Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate view to use a stage layout, putting full visual emphasis on finalizing pet details. (why: Adoption step has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and takes a long median time of 89s.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Post-Setup Launch Preparation Screen: Add a dedicated final launch preparation screen before launching the pet onto the desktop screen. (why: The overall onboarding completion rate is only 22.1%, with a 67.1% finish step conversion and 3 support complaints regarding pet visibility.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In Before Certificate: Shift sign-in screen to take place after photo upload and right before adoption certificate confirmation. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after re-signing in, requiring account binding right before certificate issuance.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Verification Flow Step: Insert a dedicated photo confirmation screen into the adoption sequence to verify rendering quality. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong during adoption.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Save Data Clarification: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly clarify that signing in binds pet save data permanently. (why: 8 emails in support complained that pets were reset or missing after signing in again.)
5: [home, hint] Waiting Screen Desktop Status Hint: Add an explicit hint on the waiting screen clarifying background setup and file placement. (why: Waiting step takes a mean of 2336s and 3 users reported pets failing to show up on the desktop.)
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Completion Alert Toggle: Enable desktop notification options and time estimates on the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting screen has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing drop-offs while waiting.)
7: [finish, layout] Full Bleed Welcome Screen Layout: Change the home_intro screen layout to full_bleed for maximum visual call-to-action impact. (why: Finish step drop-off is high (67.1% conversion) with long mean time (5815s), and past launch CTA copy changes delivered massive conversion boosts.)
8: [choose_path, hint] Story Step Flexibility Hint: Add a reassurance hint on the story screen informing users that companion choices can be adjusted later. (why: Choose path shows long mean duration (514s), suggesting user hesitation when committing to paths.)
